hardware_api_check.conclusion: No API-version mismatch. API support does not establish correct behavior of every shader or driver operation.

published_apk_packaging_check.scope: All native libraries are AArch64 and satisfy the examined 16 KB ELF/ZIP alignment requirements. Device page size is unknown; this is not a full runtime page-size or instruction-set audit.

texture_path_correction.finding: Android GLES explicitly sets s3tc_supported=false. GameData passes that capability to decode_texture, which preserves authored mip pixels in RGBA when compressed uploads are unavailable. The desktop census containing BC1 textures must not be extrapolated to Android GLES.
texture_path_correction.conclusion: Unsupported BC1/S3TC GPU decoding is not an active path in the examined Android OpenGL configuration. Authored mip handling remains a real post-1.0.0 change.

upstream_findings.topic: GLES 3D shader initialization compiles unused default variants
upstream_findings.external_evidence: A contributor reports long cold-start shader compilation stalls on Pixel 5 / Adreno 620 with Godot 4.7.2. This is a performance report, not a Redmagic crash reproduction.
upstream_findings.local_match: ShaderGLES3::_initialize_version at drivers/gles3/shader_gles3.cpp:703 compiles all modes using specialization_default_mask. drivers/gles3/shaders/scene.glsl defines four modes and defaults that enable each light type. _version_bind_shader then synchronously compiles the requested specialization if absent.
upstream_findings.interpretation: A concrete startup/compiler-work lead that can be profiled locally. Even disabled game effects do not eliminate this engine-level compilation. No evidence yet that the extra compilation causes the reported process exit.

upstream_findings.topic: Compatibility global and instance shader parameters moved from a limited UBO to a texture
upstream_findings.local_match: The shipped engine still uses the older UBO implementation. Its allocation is clamped to the hardware limit; the project's larger setting does not override that limit.
upstream_findings.limitation: Our Compatibility shaders replace instance uniforms with ordinary material uniforms in Gfx.make_shader and CameraFade. The cited per-instance node-capacity failures are therefore not a demonstrated match for this menu. Do not backport solely on this report.

upstream_findings.topic: Adreno compiler crashes on large ubershaders
upstream_findings.local_match: The compiler-version workaround already exists in our engine's drivers/vulkan/rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp.
upstream_findings.limitation: This fix addresses Vulkan compiler EV031.32.02.xx. The reported Cursed Lands session uses OpenGL, and its GLES compiler build is not supplied. Godot's vertex_lighting render mode is also different from our custom vertex-lighting calculations.

upstream_findings.topic: Adreno 840 / Qualcomm 842.xx tiler freezes reported in DXVK
upstream_findings.limitation: Same GPU and nominal driver family, but a Vulkan/DXVK workload. Not proof of an equivalent OpenGL fault, and no transferable fix verified.

upstream_findings.topic: Null GLES buffer mapping followed by memcpy
upstream_findings.local_match: Unchecked glMapBufferRange results are present in the examined canvas renderer source.
upstream_findings.limitation: The external report concerns Adreno 610 and 2D canvas rendering, with no deterministic reproducer. Our issue has no native stack establishing this failure; object-stage exit alone does not identify it.

conclusion: No confirmed unsupported CPU/GPU feature found. The strongest directly matching upstream code lead is unnecessary default GLES scene-shader compilation. Driver/engine interaction remains possible, not established. No blanket renderer switch, driver blacklist, upstream backport, or new player diagnostic build was made.
